reason_for_revision: The v1 linear mean-density-ratio gate conflated log-density scatter with bias through exponentiation and would reject a model matching Hong Table 2

one_point_density.jensen_note: Linear mean ratios are reported but are not interpreted as bias without modeling the residual distribution and its correlation with truth density

normalization_invariance.semantic_requirement: no cross-sample normalization and exact train/eval mode invariance
normalization_invariance.cuda_batch_shape_note: Absolute output differences must be compared with a deterministic CUDA test and the fixed-eval BN numerical baseline before attribution to normalization coupling

deterministic_cuda_result.interpretation: The nonzero difference is batch-shape CUDA convolution roundoff; companion identity/order and normalization mode do not affect the GroupNorm function

training_density_audit.observer_selection_bias: Training cubes are denser and less void-rich than random-volume cubes, as expected for MW-mass-centered observers

loss_imbalance.interpretation: Uniform voxel MSE strongly underweights the rare cells containing most mass and filament/peak structure

model_decision.long_training_falsification: v1 epoch-200 live-BN r(k=3-6)=0.248 < 0.40; long deterministic training is rejected
model_decision.freeze_rule: If delta r(k=3-6) is less than 0.05 versus unstandardized GroupNorm, freeze the deterministic mean model and proceed to conditional stochastic residuals
